Episode 253: Gathering Once Again inLaprarosa (2)
"Did Kelliark and Rokia meet?"
[Yeah, yeah! Moreover, they managed to secure almost all the details of the deal they made. At this point, isn't it right that you should have welcomed me with open arms?]
Jin, with a dry expression, briefly raised both his hands. As if satisfied with just that, Orgal excitedly continued the story.

[First of all, Rokia has the ability to separate Malugia from the Origin Stone. It's through the power of the Sun God that Hailyn Runcandel possesses, Araxion. And based on that, Rokia threatened Kelliark.]
"Rokia must have threatened to destroy the Origin Stone."
[Exactly. If the power of Malugia disappears, the current Origin Stone will be weakened by half. It could even get worse than that. From Kelliark's perspective, he had no choice but to accept.]
"What did Rokia demand?"
[To kill more people to keep you in check, to track Chiron with the Origin Stone, and to hand over Airan Biment.]
"The first one would have happened anyway, even without a deal. The second one... probably related to Solderet's arrangement. Airan Biment must be because of Bluggiet and Temar's left arm.”
Naturally, Lucy confirmed Airan's restrictions, that is, the curse characteristics of the Melka tribe, while torturing Bliget.
While she couldn't determine the exact fact that Temar's physical body was required to enter the Black Sea's subspace, Temar's left arm could still be used in various ways.
[Right. But it's a bit ambiguous. I don't think that bug is coming to rescue Bliget, so I'm wondering why she needs Airan's body. There must be some reason.]

“We'll look into that part. It's unlikely they can track my father easily. However, if their tracking is faster than I think, my father will surely contact me first. Is that all the information you obtained?”

[There's more. First, the stance of the Demon Army. The leader of the unified Zipple is a Zipple from another dimension, and they’re planning to destroy this world if things go wrong. Just like Elona mentioned when she briefly regained consciousness. Well, I had similar things happen when I was active in other dimensions.]
Orgal's expression darkened. But he quickly changed to a smiling face and waved his hand.

[It should be fine here since we won't let that happen. Anyway, Rokia requested that Kelliac make one report to the unified Zipple: that this world still has the potential for the Sun God's resurrection, so they should postpone its destruction.]
In no dimension has the Sun God ever been fully resurrected. That fact had already been shared by Orgal the first time he came here.
“So it seems the Sun God's resurrection is a kind of cherished goal for the Demon Army as well. Even though they have completed the Origin Stones, do they need something more?”

[Greed, and even greater greed. That's the reason the Zipples of today became thugs that span all dimensions. Since the Origin Stone is essentially an imitation of the Sun God's power, the original must be even greater. They probably can't help but want it.]

The unified Zipple destroyed numerous worlds while fighting heroes like Orgal in each dimension. Since they couldn't always win, they chose mutual destruction. Each time, a possibility for the 'complete Sun God' to be resurrected was closed off.

“I don't understand. If this is truly the last dimension, and if the Demon Army has the power to destroy this world, there's no reason for them to obsess over the Sun God. They could just destroy it and become the sole conquerors of all dimensions, and that would be the end of it. So it can't just be because of greed.”
Jin was inwardly surprised.
He hadn't expected Orgal to bring back so much information. Now there was no reason for him to attempt deceptions with nonsense like in the past, so everything he said had to be the truth.
“To think the dream ability was this powerful is quite shocking, Orgal.”
[It’s because of Ainas' immense potential. But even that looks insignificant compared to record magic. Oh, by the way, as a price for using this dream ability, Pirope has almost lost his powers.]
“What?”

[It means he can no longer be called a Demon General. There's no way to get this much information without that level of sacrifice, right? It's not like it's recording magic at its peak. Still, Ainas has taken his place as the Demon General, so there will be one or two more chances to get some good information. Though Ainas will also lose the ability when that time comes.]
“I never thought the day would come when I'd worry about Kinzelo's demons.”
[I said there will be one or two more chances to gather information.]
“That’s not what I meant. Pirope or Ainas, that ability is very precious to them, isn’t it?”

[It is precious. I'm about to tear up thinking you meant it that way. I'll be sure to tell Ainas and Pirope you were worried about them. Don't worry too much about it. As long as we can finish off the Zipples, a sacrifice like this is nothing.]
“…Orgal. After Zipple falls, what do you plan to do?”
[Suddenly?]
“Are you planning to oppose us again, like before, with the sole intention of resurrecting the Sun God?”

[Well, we'll have to see when the time comes. But now... I think just living a simple, quiet life with my members wouldn't be so bad. Resurrecting the Sun God... well, it's still attractive, but there's absolutely no way we'd side with the unified Zipple because of it.]
“That’s not what I’m worried about.”

[Of course, I figured as much. Anyway, I think the information delivery is about done here. That Kelliark in this world is pathetic. Being swayed by someone like Rokia. The Kelliarks I remember were much stronger. One of them in particular... he was immense.]
The leader of Demon Army, 33rd dimension's Kelliark Zipple.
Orgal remembered him. Although he hadn't confirmed it directly yet, he was confident that he was the leader of the unified Zipple.

[If the Demon Army invades our world directly, that guy will surely come. Let's prepare well until then. Rokia meeting Kelliark is, in many ways, actually a gain for us. Because we obtained quite a lot of information. Above all, that insect took measures to ensure the Demon God's Corps wouldn't recklessly destroy this world because of the dud Kelliark's mistake.]

“In my opinion, Rokia felt a sense of crisis. That's why she recklessly met with Kelliac and was detected by your dream ability users. She must have needed time, even if it meant taking that risk. Because there isn't much we can do immediately anyway, even if we find out about their deal.”
[I think so too. However, while there may not be much we can do, there’s still something we can do.]
“The egos of the Sun God.”
[Yes.]
Postponement of destruction by the Demon Army.
According to Rokia, the egos of the Sun God were essential for that. And right now, the Vamel Alliance was tracking the newly discovered egos, Nepdol and Beltian.
"We’ll allocate more resources to track Beltian. You focus more on Nepdol."

[We should. Jin Runcandel, just as you said, Rokia used her authority recklessly to meet Kelliark. Therefore, the faster we resolve the issue with those two egos, the better. Before Rokia recovers her strength and ruins our plans.]
For Jin, it was a moment of decision.

If more resources were allocated to search for Beltian in Laprarosa, the personnel available to monitor the Tower of Stories would decrease. Inevitably, this meant that more civilian massacres would occur.
It was a painful choice, but...
For now, focusing on Beltian was the only option. Jin being dragged into civilian massacres was exactly what the enemy wanted.
One day, one hour, one second faster. He had to secure Beltian. On the contrary, he had to draw the enemies in, so that they couldn't even dream of massacring civilians.
To Laprarosa, where Beltian is.

[Right now, the only forces Rokia can send are low-level ones like Joshua. Although they say they've awakened with the power of Ganesto, you know better than I do that those guys aren't anything special. They'll probably just hide and throw themselves at Beltian when they get the chance.]
“We still have to be careful, as they could use special tools or something.”

[Of course, I know. Well then, I’ll go track down Nepdol immediately. Oh, and just a word of caution. Don’t go off and kill Bliget because of your rage. If that guy is destroyed, the Sun God’s resurrection is gone, and the Demon Army will lose interest in this dimension.]
"I’ll keep that in mind."
[Of course, we could win an all-out war with the Demon Army, but it's better to have as many cards as possible. Well then, goodbye...! Ah, wait. Jin, aren't you forgetting something?]
"What do you mean?"
[You have to say thank you to me, you punk.]
"We’ll leave that for later."

Jin answered as such and gently pushed Orgal through the steel dimensional gate. Orgal poked his face back out of the steel gate a couple of times, but Jin shoved him back in as if playing whack-a-mole.
Orgal’s curses echoed briefly, and Jin immediately gathered his comrades.

“We are going to Laprarosa. Nepdol's side will be left entirely to Kinzelo. The forces to be dispatched will be all personnel, excluding the fleet currently tracking the Tower of Tales, those dispatched for civilian support, and a minimum force for homeland defense.”
“Young Lord, shall we prepare immediately?”
"Yes, we depart immediately."
Thanks to the Golden Fleet’s mobility, the troops were quickly assembled.
Jin, along with Murakan, Lucy, and Bliget, boarded the flagship, Sarah, and headed towards the Battle God Temple. The reason for bringing Bliget was to find Beltian faster.

"You're lucky, Bliget. Thanks to a change in plans, you'll be seeing the world outside again, a place you thought you would never see. But, if you try any funny business, you’ll be having a long talk with me in the dungeon of Tikan Palace."
Lucy patted Bliget’s shoulder as she spoke. Bliget let out a sigh and could only nod in agreement.

“Luci, you've gotten pretty savage. An old saying goes, 'There's no champion against a gang beating.' It's a saying that this great Murakan has also experienced from time to time. Let's hurry up and beat down that Beltian bastard or whatever, and really screw those jerks over.”
